## Appearance

Stacy has fair, curly hair, which has been described as exceptionally lovely. She is also noted for having fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a careful, tactful, and broadminded guide to those under her care. She demonstrates great skill as an educator, maintaining perfect discipline and order without ever resorting to physical punishment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

_Not yet known._

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school trustees as the town's new teacher, deciding to return to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) despite having considered a position in her home district. She introduced field trips and organized a Christmas concert with her students to raise funds for a school flag. After confirming that she would return for another year of teaching, she guided the Queen's class as they prepared for their [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a teacher, mentor, and true friend to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She guides [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through her studies and field trips, preparing her for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations while encouraging extracurricular activities such as organizing a school Christmas concert to raise money for a flag. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly anticipates learning under her and thrives in her class, forming a warm, supportive bond with her teacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
